affinity.meaning: One logical processor; no exclusive core reservation or fixed frequency

timing_scope: Complete preloaded PCM validation, frontend, ONNX, finite decoding and policy. Excludes WAV/disk, wake/VAD, spoken duration, 400ms endpoint and UI/transport. Cold first call separate.
memory_scope: Process high-water RSS includes Python, runtime, one PCM clip, catalog, corpus metadata and retained result records; not model-only RAM.
